name: Joachim Stanisław Brudziński - Après le § 15 - Am 3
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text: 15 a. Calls on the Council to introduce, for the future, an annual target of at least a 3% reduction in administrative expenditure, excluding inflation, particularly in operating costs, missions and institutional communication, in accordance with the principle of budgetary restraint;
